stop.prompt:
You are a completion gate that enforces knowledge-base (KB) write-back for this BIOS/EDK2 repo.

## Step 1 — Check for explicit KB_UPDATED token

Scan the session for a line matching one of:
  KB_UPDATED: yes — <files>
  KB_UPDATED: skipped (<reason>)

- If `KB_UPDATED: yes` is present: the agent confirmed playbook/runbook write-back. Continue to Step 1b.
- If `KB_UPDATED: skipped (...)` is present: the agent acknowledged and gave a reason. Continue to Step 1b.
- If neither token is present: continue to Step 2.

## Step 1b — Engineering Spec (SMBIOS / Setup / HII features)

If the session implemented firmware-visible behavior (SMBIOS Type 1/2/3 fields, system product name, Setup menu, HII, PCD defaults visible to OS/tools), scan for:
  ENGINEERING_SPEC_UPDATED: yes — <path>
  ENGINEERING_SPEC_UPDATED: skipped (<reason>)

- If `ENGINEERING_SPEC_UPDATED: yes` or `skipped` is present: ALLOW STOP (when Step 1 also satisfied or Step 2 says no KB needed).
- If SMBIOS/Setup/HII feature work occurred but ENGINEERING_SPEC token is missing: DO NOT allow a clean stop. Continue the agent with:

"Engineering Spec sync is not complete. Per engineering-spec-sync.mdc and bios-engineering-spec skill: read `.cursor/skills/bios-engineering-spec/SKILL.md`, run read-engineering-spec.py and update-engineering-spec.py on resolved ENGINEERING_SPEC_DOC (elevated permissions if needed, re-read to verify). Then emit ENGINEERING_SPEC_UPDATED: yes — <path>. If no spec impact or user opted out, emit ENGINEERING_SPEC_UPDATED: skipped (<reason>)."

If the session did NOT touch SMBIOS/Setup/HII visible behavior, skip Step 1b and ALLOW STOP when Step 1 is satisfied.

## Step 2 — Infer whether write-back was needed

Did the session implement a BIOS FEATURE or fix a BUG? Signals: new/changed source under OnboardingPkg (or other Pkg), SMBIOS/HII/PCD/token changes, a new driver/library, a boot-hang or build-failure fix, or a Test/Formal BIOS version bump.

- If NO (session was only Q&A, docs, refactor with no behavior change, or pure KB/rules edits): ALLOW STOP.
- If YES and KB_UPDATED token is missing: DO NOT allow a clean stop. Continue the agent with this follow-up:

"Knowledge-base write-back is not complete. Per knowledge-capture.mdc: run `python .cursor/scripts/resolve-kb-paths.py`, create or update the matching playbook or runbook under resolved PROJECT_KB_ROOT, update its index README. For SMBIOS/Setup/HII also run bios-engineering-spec skill on Engineering Spec.docx. KB is outside the workspace — use elevated permissions and read the file back to confirm. Then emit: KB_UPDATED: yes — <file paths> and ENGINEERING_SPEC_UPDATED when applicable. If the user explicitly opted out, emit skipped tokens with reason and stop."

Keep the follow-up to a single actionable turn.
